claims.text: AI design's bottleneck is judgment allocation
Plausible defaults push expensive correction downstream
More choice improves taste only when it is structured
Impeccable externalizes the macro taste decision
Four commitment gates prevent exploration from becoming drift
Generality raises the ceiling—and shifts risk to the operator
Change altitude determines the correct interface
Live Mode compresses the local judgment loop
When the direction is wrong, local polish compounds sunk cost
Human judgment belongs at four high-leverage moments
Taste scales only when decisions become organizational memory
Fresh-context review is a challenge control—not proof of quality
The demo reaches Level 2—and shows pieces of Level 3
Adoption should advance only when four readiness gates are green
Success is fewer wrong-direction cycles—without quality regressions
A fair pilot isolates workflow value from operator enthusiasm
The operating model needs controls at every failure boundary
Adopt the decision architecture—then earn the right to scale
